techStack: React 19.0.0, Vite 6.2.0, TypeScript ~5.7.2 — ESM project, bundler module resolution
Vitest 3.2.4 + @testing-library/react 16.3.2 + jsdom; tests run via `pnpm --filter benchmark-frontend test --run`
verbatimModuleSyntax: true — requires `import type` for type-only imports (already followed in productFilters.ts)
noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters TS flags — TypeScript acts as linter; `tsc -b` runs before build
No ESLint/Prettier; relative imports throughout; no path aliases
`filterProducts` is already imported in App.tsx line 7 — no new import statement needed for the refactor
features: `filterProducts(products: Product[], filters: FilterState): Product[]` — applies search, category, inStock filters then sorts; defined in src/utils/productFilters.ts
`normalizeSearch(val: string): string` — trims and lowercases; exported from productFilters.ts but never imported or called anywhere else; confirmed dead code
`visibleProducts` useMemo in App.tsx lines 19–44 — re-implements filter+sort inline despite `filterProducts` being imported; the import is currently dead weight

`handleCategoryChange` in FilterPanel.tsx — `const cat = e.target.value === 'all' ? 'All' : e.target.value;` — ternary true-branch is permanently unreachable because all `<option>` values are title-cased 'All'

Must-not-regress features: search by name, category dropdown, in-stock checkbox, sort (price-asc/price-desc/rating-desc/default), clear filters, loading spinner, error alert, pagination (Prev/Next, page count, results-count)
Test files: app.render.test.tsx, clearFilters.test.tsx, filtering.test.tsx, loadingError.test.tsx, pagination.test.tsx, sorting.test.tsx — all read-only
architecture: Layer flow: main.tsx → App.tsx → useProductFilters (hook) → productsApi (API) + productFilters (util) → FilterPanel / SortSelect / ProductList / Spinner (components)
Utility functions live in src/utils/; types centralised in src/types/product.ts with FilterState co-located in productFilters.ts
`filterProducts` defined at productFilters.ts line 15; imported in App.tsx line 7 as `import { filterProducts } from './utils/productFilters'`
FilterPanel and SortSelect are fully controlled — all filter state lives in useProductFilters; props flow down from App
Changes scope: App.tsx (useMemo body only), productFilters.ts (remove export), FilterPanel.tsx (simplify handler) — no new files or layers needed
edgeCases: `filterProducts` signature exactly matches App.tsx's needs — `filterProducts(products, filters)` is a valid call with existing local variables

Behavioral equivalence confirmed: inline `!p.inStock` vs filterProducts' `p.inStock === true` are identical when inStock is typed boolean; no-sort path returns same filtered array; only difference is an extra upfront array copy inside filterProducts (not observable)
`normalizeSearch` grep returns zero hits outside productFilters.ts — removal cannot break any consumer
`<option>` values are always raw category strings from the 'All'-headed array — `'all'` (lowercase) is never a possible select value, confirming dead branch is safe to remove
Removing the dead branch simplifies handleCategoryChange to `onChange({ ...filters, category: e.target.value })` — preserves 'All' pass-through since the select already emits 'All'
No package.json or pnpm-lock.yaml changes needed — filterProducts already imported, no new modules required

tasks.requirement: 2 — normalizeSearch is entirely removed from productFilters.ts
tasks.description: Delete the comment on line 10 and the `normalizeSearch` function declaration on lines 11–13 from productFilters.ts. No other file imports or calls this function, so no other file needs updating.
